Ok been playing this build the last few days and I gotta say it's more fun and better than I expected. I mostly play turf war so I don't know what it's application, if any, would be in ranked.

That said, it took a minute to get use to, it was my first time using burst bombs. Going to touch on some "no shit" information really quick.

Bomb range will vary based on the momentum of your character. Standing still the burst bombs with this set up as it is are just shy of the same distance as a basic splat charger. You can get splash dmg but not a direct hit unless in an exact straight line. If I could reroll the boots to a third minor bomb range instead of defense it would be the same. Add a little momentum and you can out distance the splat chargers and hit elite 3ks with splash damage.

With 4 minor ink recoveries and 2 minor sub reductions you can throw burst bombs at the swimming momentum pretty much indefinitely. The small amount of time it takes to re-position yourself after throwing so you don't gradually move forward, then swim just enough to throw your second bomb is just enough to refill your ink. This allows you to block paths from a safe distance, torment snipers, and dmg people from further away than they would expect.

Then when you start adding the bombs into just standard gunfights you can do a lot of quick dmg if not outright kill them before they even get in gun range, then one shot will finish them off usually. With practice you start annoying people all over the map, tapping them a couple times from a distance to force them to move or distract them while they're fighting other people. Really makes me wish this game had some kind of assist counter.
